parsed.observations: Wheat stems and leaf sheaths show numerous elongated brick-red pustules with ragged, split epidermis, especially near the central node. Leaves show yellow mottling and some drying; no distinct yellow pustule stripes, white powdery growth, or black-dotted blotches are visible.
parsed.summary: Stem rust is strongly supported by elongated brick-red pustules rupturing the epidermis on stems and leaf sheaths.
